theorems.name: Submission.bv_convolution_bound_and_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ρ F : Rn n → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), (∀ x, |ρ x| ≤ A) → LipschitzWith K ρ → Integrable F volume → ∀ x y : Rn n, |convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x| ≤ A * (∫ t, |F t|) ∧ |convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x - convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ * (∫ t, |F t|)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
